messages:
meera: Heads-up: AP-South-2 (mumbai) region prep — need routing + residency signoff before next week's cutover. Quick ownership and blocker check.

alex: meera, I can own routing policy changes (edge rules + egress). Need list of downstream services that must whitelist the new CIDRs.

juan: I can pick up KMS/DB residency checks. Do we have a dedicated DB replica planned for mumbai?

meera: No replica yet. Planned approach: proxy -> existing read-replica in ap-south-1 for initial launch, then local replica in Q2. @juan can you confirm latency SLO with that?

juan: Will run perf tests. Also need guidance on backups retention in region (compliance). Natalie — any legal constraints for IN region?

natalie: India data residency: for user PII we need at-rest keys managed in KMS with customer-specific CMKs preferred. I'll send the compliance checklist. Not a hard block but needs documented controls.

alex: For whitelists: I'll open a PR to infra-config and ping oncall. Rough CIDR: 10.240.0.0/16 (internal) + public egress via nat-aps2. PR by EOD.

deploybot: deploybot: New PR opened by alex: infra-config#582 — automated tests passed :white_check_mark: 

meera: Thanks. Two more quick asks: 1) Any canary plan? 2) Fallback routing if ap-south-2 capacity constrained.

juan: Canary: 5% traffic to aps2 via weight routing for 48h. Fallback: autoscale to dedicated-hosts in ap-south-1 and route via last-mile egress — needs runbook.

alex: I'll add canary helm values and a routing rule: weight=0.05, retry=2. Snippet:
```
route:
  canary:
    weight: 0.05
    retry: 2
```
Will attach PR.

natalie: If canary sees data residency drift we must pause and escalate. Add a monitoring alert for cross-region-data-access metric.

meera: Great. Next steps: alex PR, juan perf test + KMS checklist, natalie compliance doc. If no objections I’ll mark owners in the project board and schedule handoff. :thumbsup:

alex: :thumbsup: working on PR now

juan: Perf tests scheduled in 2 hours, will post results here.

deploybot: incident-bot: Scheduled perf job started (job id perf-aps2-333) — progress updates will be posted.
